summary: In Tirisfal Glades, Executor Zygand directs the Forsaken campaign against the Scarlet Crusade. With intelligence recovered by Executor Arren, you are sent to strike Scarlet Warriors at a guard tower west of the Solliden Farmstead. The attack opens the Forsaken military effort to drive the crusaders from their borders.

sections.title: A Two-Front War
sections.body: The Forsaken state under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner faces threats on several fronts. The Deathguard watches the growing armies of the Lich King, while the Scarlet Crusade contests Forsaken dominance over their former homeland. The Crusade condemns all undead as abominations to be purged with fire and blade. Its zealots fail to see that the Forsaken have broken free of the Scourge’s control.

sections.title: Striking the Western Outpost
sections.body: Executor Arren secured intelligence documents at Deathknell, giving Executor Zygand the locations of Scarlet encampments and outposts across Tirisfal Glades. With Deathguard garrisons occupied containing the Scourge, independent Forsaken champions are sent to strike the zealots directly. The first target is a guard tower west of Solliden Farmstead, where Scarlet Warriors gather and threaten the western approaches to Brill.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade hostile toward the Forsaken?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade is an extremist human order devoted to eradicating the undead. Its members make no distinction between the mindless Scourge under the Lich King and the free-willed Forsaken loyal to Lady Sylvanas. They see every undead being as a plague-ridden monster that must be burned.

Executor Zygand is the senior military officer of the Forsaken Deathguard stationed in Brill. He directs tactical deployments, defends the roads around the capital’s approaches, and oversees offensive strikes against nearby Scarlet and Scourge forces.

faq.q: How did the Forsaken get intelligence on Scarlet positions?
aliases: how did they find the tower
faq.answer: Recruits serving Executor Arren recovered tactical documents in Deathknell. The papers detailed Scarlet patrol routes, outposts, and encampments throughout Tirisfal, giving Executor Zygand the information to plan targeted counter-attacks.

faq.q: Where are the Scarlet Warriors located?
faq.answer: Scarlet Warriors hold a defensive tower west of the Solliden Farmstead, in the western countryside of Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why doesn't the Deathguard handle the Crusade directly?
faq.answer: The Deathguard’s formal ranks are stretched thin watching the Scourge, whose forces grow in number each night under the Lich King’s reach. Unable to spare regular soldiers from containment, Zygand relies on ambitious, unassigned champions to cull the Crusaders.

faq.q: Does this mission end the Scarlet presence in Tirisfal?
aliases: is this the last scarlet quest
faq.answer: No. The attack on the western watchtower is the first strike in a four-part campaign directed by Executor Zygand to dismantle Scarlet command and outposts across the region.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you face living former countrymen who call you monsters and seek your eradication instead of mourning Lordaeron’s tragic fall.
As Horde, you need a secure border around Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity to give the Horde a permanent foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms.
